necessity: The cp82 first-terminal video failure retained only ARK_PROVIDER_ERROR, which was insufficient to distinguish provider validation, transport, authentication, or transient service behavior without a blind paid retry.

change.arkJob: Persist only the already-sanitized DomainError details on synchronous submit and poll failures so idempotent replay and restart retain the diagnostic.
change.commercialJob: Retain a bounded Ark diagnostic containing provider, category, optional upstream HTTP status, safe provider code/parameter, and a one-way request-id fingerprint.
change.redaction: Provider messages, response bodies, URLs, credentials, tokens, and arbitrary fields are not persisted in the commercial job diagnostic.

deployment.reason: Activating a release requires separately confirmed process control under the workspace operating rules.
